CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: Added ShaderIPSLight to the shankpit materials validShaderNames registry; NOCK's Materials panel gets a real shader picker (standard/ips_light) and its per-material Delete button is removed to prevent accidentally orphaning a hooked-up material from its shader. Commit 8d7f2fa (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
